task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an fast paced round of TextWorld? You do! First off, attempt to head west. Then, make an attempt to move west. That done, try to move north. If you can accomplish that, try to head north. Then, attempt to go north. If you can do that, try to venture east. Next, make an attempt to move east. After that, go to the east. That done, venture south. Following that, make an effort to travel west. Then, travel west. With that done, recover the cookie from the floor of the steam room. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
description:
You've entered a dish-pit.

You can see a pan. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of garbage. This always happens, here in TextWorld! You can see a plate. The plate is typical. But the thing is empty, unfortunately.

There is an open hatch leading south. There is an open gate leading west.

thought: I will attempt to head west as the first step.
feedback:
Well I'll be, you are in a place we're calling a bathroom. You start to take note of what's in the room.

You can make out a cabinet. Now why would someone leave that there?

There is an open gate leading east. There is an open gateway leading west. There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unguarded.
